visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male vendor wearing a navy and white striped jacket is seen from the chest down, standing behind a stainless steel grill. He uses a large kitchen knife to carefully separate pieces of white skewered seafood, including squid tentacles and round balls, which are being cooked over red-hot charcoal. The background features a rustic red brick wall and part of a green sign, illuminated by warm overhead stall lights. (2) A man with styled dark hair, wearing a light blue short-sleeved shirt covered in white duck patterns with red hats, is shown in a medium close-up. He is biting into a skewer with a focused expression, his eyebrows slightly raised and eyes darting to the side as he chews. Behind him, the blurred lights and yellow umbrellas of a busy outdoor night market create a vibrant, bokeh-filled background. (3) The camera pans to a static shot of a food stall counter where a small, taxidermied crocodile is perched on top of a white box, its jaws wide open to reveal rows of teeth. Below it, several bowls on a bed of ice hold raw seafood skewers, and illuminated signs above display "Grilled Squid Tentacles" with a price of 60. The lighting is bright and focused, highlighting the texture of the crocodile skin. (4) Returning to the grill, the vendor is now holding a white and blue portable blowtorch, directing a large, fierce orange flame onto the skewered food. The intense heat causes the seafood to sizzle and slightly char, while the vendor maintains a steady hand. He wears a black baseball cap and a serious, focused facial expression, with the red brick wall still visible in the shallow background. (5) The man in the duck-patterned shirt stands in the middle of a crowded walkway, holding up a long wooden skewer featuring various pieces of grilled meat and green peppers. He reacts with wide eyes and an open mouth, showing pieces of food between his teeth as he talks excitedly to an off-camera companion. A young child and other pedestrians walk by in the background, amidst the bright neon signs and stall structures of the night market.

The creator is tricked by a friend into eating grilled crocodile meat, and the core appeal lies in his authentic, exaggerated reaction of surprise and disgust when the true nature of the meat is revealed.
